usage.callShape: POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/messages with JSON body {model, max_tokens, messages:[{role,content}]}
quirks: model field must be the BlockRun slug "anthropic/claude-opus-4.8" (not bare "claude-opus-4.8")
standard Anthropic Messages API shape: max_tokens and messages[] are required
price varies by token usage; this tiny call cost $0.001
usage.guide: Call POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/messages with an Anthropic Messages API JSON body: set model to "anthropic/claude-opus-4.8", include max_tokens and a messages array of {role,content} objects. Payment is x402 USDC on Base, handled automatically by the pay tool; no API key needed. Read the assistant reply from body.content[0].text and token usage from body.usage. Cost varies with tokens (a minimal call was $0.001).
